name: Uncertainty range
definition: Range or band instead of a single point (e.g. 1.2–1.6 million).

demo.how: A falsely precise point estimate (1.43 million) appears first, then widens into the honest range, 1.2–1.6 million, and finally a darker inner band marks the likeliest half. The headline changes with it, so the slide never claims more certainty than the model has. Values are illustrative.
